title: manni terminology strict overlay v1.1.0
description: The strict overlay for manni:terminology:1.1.0. Stack it beside the open vocabulary. It narrows the form of values the open vocabulary already claims and requires no key. An entry either defines its term or redirects with `see`, so strict rejects a page that carries both. The open vocabulary leaves that case to `manni term check`. Strict also closes the TBX picklists to the values TBX names, holds a subject field, a designation's term and a link's target to one trimmed line, and requires each `tbx-elements` item to be an element.
